appPasswordsDesc: App passwords purane mail clients ko bina main password ke sign in karne dete hain. Har password sirf ek baar dikhaya jata hai.
appPasswordsNote: Sirf demo: ye passwords aapke browser me bante hain, kisi server par store nahi hote.
demoAccountNote: Sirf demo: ye Account Centre aapke browser me demo session par chalta hai. Koi asli account nahi banta aur kuch server par nahi bheja jata.
devicesDesc: Is account se sign in hue devices. Session revoke karne par wo device sign out ho jayega.
forgotPasswordNote: Apna email address dalo. Agar account hai to reset link bhej di jayegi.
inviteOnlyNote: Public sign-up abhi khula nahi hai. Phase 1 me sign-up ke liye invite code chahiye. Code ke bina koi account nahi banega.
passwordMismatch: Naye passwords match nahi kar rahe.
passwordTooShort: Naya password kam se kam 8 characters ka hona chahiye.
profileDesc: Poore suite ke liye aapka naam, photo aur recovery email.
recoveryPasswordDesc: Password bhoolne par reset link se account wapas mil jata hai.
recoverySeedDesc: Seed phrase khone par purana encrypted mail dobara nahi khul sakta. Password reset khui hui seed wapas nahi lata.
recoveryWarning: Password recovery aur seed recovery ek nahi hain. Dono ko alag rakho.
resetLinkSent: Agar is email address ka account hai to reset link bhej di gayi hai.
sessionsNote: Sirf demo sessions hain. Asli session list auth service se aayegi.
showOnce: Ye password sirf ek baar dikhaya jayega. Abhi copy kar lo.
signInTitle: Apne Dusrel account me sign in karo
twoFactorDesc: Password ke baad authenticator app ka second code chahiye hoga.
